title: History Brought To Life With Breathtaking Colorizations (Animated)
description:
► Hi everyone and nice to see you back. The following video is brought to you in collaboration with Jecinci Colorizations. Jecinci is an architect and 3D artist from Romania with a passion for colorizing black and white photos from history. Few years back he saw a YouTube tutorial on photo restoration and colorization and he never looked back since. He first started colorizing family photos and then moved onto historical ones. Todate he has colorized nearly 2000 photos and he has no intention in stopping any time sooner. "Colorizing  historical photos opens a vibrant and dynamic window into the past, through which memories become a vivid reality", Jecinci said. Jecinci's colorizations truly stand out and I invite you to see some of his work in this video. Don’t forget to check the bonus facial animations in the end.

Featured in this video:

08:20 | The Birth Of The Flag, 1905
09:10 | The Tallest, Shortest and Fattest, 1913
09:45 | Arthur Fields, 1910s
10:22 | Facial Animations
